title: Customer deduction reason codes
content:
Codes customers put on a remittance when they pay less than an invoice. Each code maps to one dispute category. When a payment carries a deduction, apply what was paid and open a dispute for the deducted amount under the mapped category.
TPR-01: trade_promotion. Promotional allowance or co-op advertising the customer believes it is owed.
PRC-01: pricing_variance. Invoiced above the customer's agreed price.
FRT-01: freight. A freight charge the customer says it should not pay.
FRT-02: freight. Penalty the customer takes when a delivery arrives after the promised date.
SHT-01: shortage. Fewer units received than invoiced.
DMG-01: damaged_goods. Goods arrived damaged.
QLT-01: quality. Goods arrived intact but are defective or not to specification.
DLV-01: delivery. Delivered to the wrong site or the wrong recipient.
DUP-01: duplicate_charge. The same goods or service invoiced twice.
